name: Middletown Data Center

profile.reading: Per Middletown Data Center own site, this Virginia facility totals 43,400 square feet of data center space, with 14 MW of total power and 10 MW of critical IT load. No exact street address is published; the page places it roughly 57 miles from Ashburn, Virginia and 50 miles from Washington, DC.
